newsitem.title: FRANCE: UAP to be merged into Axa.
newsitem.headline: UAP to be merged into Axa.

text.p: Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP) is to be merged into Axa on the basis of four Axa shares plus four certificates of guaranteed value for 10 UAP shares, a joint statement from the two insurance companies said on Tuesday.

"In June of 1999, if the AXA share is trading below 392.50 francs per share (the equivalent of 157 francs per UAP share), each certificate will entitle its bearer to cash payment of the difference," the English-language statement said.

"Cash payout on the certificate is limited to 80 francs per share, or 32 francs per UAP share. The certificate will be listed, and will have an immediate theoretical value estimated at 47.60 francs, or 19 francs per UAP share," it said.
UAP shares, suspended on Tuesday, closed on Friday at 116.9 francs per share, compared to a 1994 privatisation price of 152 francs per share.
The statement said that based on the average trading price of UAP stock over the last three months, the deal offered shareholders an immediate global premium of 39 percent.
